mechanisms.name: suppression of grain growth by simultaneous dissolution of Fe, Cr and Ti

evidence.quote: The simultaneous dissolution of Fe, Cr and Ti elements into the icosahedral and Al phases suppresses the grain growth of the two phases in the Al-Fe-Cr-Ti alloys subjected to the long-time annealing treatment.

mechanisms.name: suppression of coarsening of icosahedral particles and difficulty of plastic deformation of Al phase

evidence.quote: That is, the remarkable improvement of elevated-temperature strength is attributable to the combination of the suppression of coarsening of the icosahedral particles and the difficulty of the plastic deformation of the Al phase.
